newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-PELE FAILS MORAL STANDARDS FOR HONORAY CITIZENSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PELE FAILS MORAL STANDARDS FOR HONORAY CITIZENSHIP.

text.p: Brazil's Pele may be his country's soccer legend but he does not have the moral standards to become an honorary citizen of the Federal District of Brasilia, the president of Brasilia's legislative council said on Tuesday.

"I think he has spoken out very little about the black race and he also showed himself when he did not acknowledge paternity," Lucia Carvalho said after a council meeting in which Pele was denied honorary citizenship.
"This eliminates him from being made an honorary citizen," she added.

Pele is the biological father of a 31-year old shopkeeper who lives in Santos, according to a Brazilian court ruling based upon the results of a DNA test. Pele has said in interviews that while Sandra Regina Machado may be his biological daughter, he can not feel any emotional attachment because he does not know her.
Brasilia is Brazil's capital and home to the country's Congress where Pele currently holds the post of Special Sports Minister.
